title: Shadowmoon Lens
summary: Jecia binds a level-70 Shadowmoon version of the lens through Earthmender Wilda instead of Oronok, using a fresh quest and fresh item identity.

beats.label: Shadowmoon Signal
beats.description: The lens points away from Oronok's stale quest path and toward Earthmender Wilda's nearby elemental trouble.

beats.label: Quiet The Water
beats.description: Jecia breaks nearby Enraged Water Spirits so the reward comes from the zone she is actually playing in.

beats.label: Fit The Reward
beats.description: The reward is a level-70 item-level-125 head item with a fresh item identity and the working fixed-reward quest row shape.

quest.title: Jecia: Shadowmoon Lens
quest.quest_description: The lens pulls a clean line through Shadowmoon Valley's broken waters. Quiet the nearby Enraged Water Spirits, then return to Earthmender Wilda.
quest.request_items_text: Quiet 6 Enraged Water Spirits, then report to Earthmender Wilda.
quest.offer_reward_text: Wilda studies the lens and nods toward the waterline. The spirit in it finally has a shape she trusts.

conversation_steering.body: Prefer arc proof targets and rewards that match Jecia's current level, current zone, and current gear tier instead of starter-zone reuse.
Never reuse visible quest, item, spell, creature, or object IDs for failed or stale content iterations. Retire the old ID and publish a fresh ID.

prompt_queue.body: Offer the next Jecia branch from current Outland context: Shadowmoon zone pressure, companion upgrades, or a level-70 item-granted ability.

notes: Live publish for this iteration changes the questgiver to Earthmender Wilda, uses a fresh quest ID and item ID, overwrites LogDescription and QuestCompletionLog, and clears visible money so copper cannot be interpreted as an item entry.
